The missing piece

Your audience follows you because they want to move more. But watching isn't moving.

Inspiration gets people to the starting line. It rarely gets them to week three. Motiv gives the people who already look to you a way to act on it — with you.

The collab

A short challenge you lead and your followers love.

A 4–6 week challenge built around how you already move — running, riding, walking. Followers join, and everyone follows through together.

  • Personal goals. Each person's target comes from their own recent activity. — fair for everyone.
  • Move your way. Goals track steps, active minutes, or active calorie burn. — with more metrics on the way — so any kind of movement counts.
  • Tracked passively. Syncs from Apple Watch, Fitbit, Garmin, WHOOP, Oura and more. — no logging, no honor system.
  • A shared finish line. One feed, one timeline. — your videos carrying everyone through.

Why it works

Three things, working together

Information alone doesn't change behavior. Neither does motivation. What works is structure that makes showing up the obvious choice — week after week.

A goal that's truly theirs

A weekly target built from each person's own recent activity. — a real stretch for a beginner and a marathoner alike. Nobody's set up to fail; nobody can coast.

A reason to follow through

Joining includes a small refundable deposit — we call it a hold. Meet your weekly goal and it comes back in full., plus rewards. Not a fee, not a bet — a commitment to yourself, made real.

A group moving with you

Hundreds of people on one timeline., watching your videos, cheering each other on. Quitting alone is easy. Quitting on the group — and on you — isn't.

How you earn

You already do the work. Motiv pays you for it.

No products to push, no course to script, no brand to answer to — just the showing up you already do, turned into real revenue. Three ways a collab pays you:

01

When people join

Recruitment pay

You earn as your collab clears participant milestones. Your announcement post is the launch; your audience is the distribution.

02

When you show up weekly

Content pay

Post a short, motivating video each week — the kind you already make. Every one earns a set amount, scaled to your collab's size.

03

Performance bonus

When a collab does well financially, you share in the upside. Close with a wrap-up, crown your MVPs, and the best ones bring the community back.

The experience

What your audience gets

A collab isn't content to consume. It's 4 to 6 weeks of structure, momentum, and shared effort — wrapped around your voice. Here's what it looks like inside the app.

Creator app
Follower app

Joining

A goal made for them, before they put down their hold

They see everything up front: the pool, the rules, the dates — and a personal weekly goal built from their own wearable history. No generic targets, no surprises — and the hold comes back in full when they follow through.

  • Connect a wearable — Apple Watch, Fitbit, Garmin, WHOOP, Oura and more. Tracking is fully passive.
  • See the exact goal built from their recent activity, at the difficulty you set.
  • Place the hold — a refundable deposit returned in full when they follow through.

During

Progress they can feel, every single day

Each week has a goal, and every bit of movement counts toward it. Activity syncs from their wearable on its own — so participants just move and watch their progress climb.

  • Live weekly progress — this week's total, the days they've moved, and how close they are to hitting goal.
  • Nothing hidden — every synced day is visible, week by week, so their progress is always theirs to check.
  • The pool, live — everyone's commitment and momentum, in one shared view.

Your presence

Your voice carries the collab

Each week you post a short video — a check-in, a nudge, a story from your training. It's the content you already make, for an audience that's doing it with you.

  • Built in your voice — Motiv's AI designs a starting point that already looks and feels like your brand, so you skip the hours of setup. You tweak it until it's yours.
  • Weekly videos surface front-and-center for every participant.
  • One shared feed where the group posts, replies, and trades high-fives.
  • MVPs at the finish — you crown Most Improved and Most Supportive when it wraps.

Your audience stops only reading your content and starts living it.

How it works

From idea to finish line

You bring the voice and the audience. Motiv handles goals, tracking, payments, and logistics. Here's the whole arc.

01

Design your collab

Motiv's AI scans your socials and drafts a collab that looks and sounds like you. Set the activity, length, and difficulty — then tweak.

02

Announce it

Share your link wherever your audience lives. Followers join in minutes — connect, see their goal, place their hold.

03

Lead the weeks

Post a short video each week and move alongside everyone. Motiv tracks the rest automatically.

04

Wrap and celebrate

Close with a wrap-up, crown your MVPs, send refunds and rewards. Then plan the next — they'll ask.

For participants

Simple on purpose

The participant experience is deliberately light: join once, then just move. No manual logging, no daily check-in chores, no app babysitting.

  • Join — connect a wearable, see a personal goal, place a refundable hold.
  • Move — hit the weekly goal; activity syncs on its own.
  • Finish — full refund plus rewards, and a habit that survived five weeks.

The fine print, up front

Honest mechanics

  • The hold is refundable — meet your weekly goals and it comes back in full, plus rewards.
  • Goals are personal — built from each person's own history, so the bar is fair for everyone.
  • Data is verified — movement comes from wearables, not the honor system.

FAQ

Fair questions, straight answers

A 4–6 week movement challenge you host for your audience. Participants join, connect a wearable, get a personal weekly goal from their own activity history, and move toward it together — with your weekly videos carrying the group.
No. It's a refundable deposit — typically $20–$50 — placed when a participant joins. Meet the weekly goals and it comes back in full, plus rewards. A small, real commitment dramatically improves follow-through: a promise to yourself with a receipt.
No. No wagering, no odds, no chance. The outcome is entirely in each participant's control: meet your goal, get your money back plus rewards. It's a commitment device — the mechanism behind deposit-based behavior-change programs studied for decades.
Goals are calculated from each participant's own recent wearable history — typically the last three weeks — then raised by a difficulty level you choose for the collab. Because goals come from verified data rather than self-reports, sandbagging doesn't work, and a beginner and a veteran each get a target that's honest for them.
Three things: announce the collab to your audience, post a short video each week while it runs, and close it out with a wrap-up where you crown your MVPs. Motiv handles goals, tracking, payments, refunds, and support. If you already post regularly, this is the work you already do.
Three streams: recruitment pay as your collab clears participant milestones, content pay for each weekly video you post, and a performance bonus when you close out the collab well. Recruitment pay is guaranteed once you reach 200 participants, and content pay is guaranteed whenever you post — all the math is visible before you launch. Payouts run through Stripe.
Apple Watch, Fitbit, Garmin, WHOOP, Oura, and most major trackers. Participants connect once during signup, and everything tracks passively from there — no manual logging.
No. Engaged beats enormous. A creator with 15,000 followers who move can run a stronger collab than one with a million passive viewers. What matters is that your audience follows you for movement and trusts your voice.

Trust

Our commitments

Motiv only works if participants trust the mechanics and creators trust the platform. These aren't marketing lines — they're how the product is built.

No. 1

Follow through, get refunded

The hold is returned in full to everyone who meets their goals — automatically, on schedule, every time. The rules are stated plainly before anyone pays, and they don't change mid-collab.

No. 2

Rewards make it worth it

Participation should feel like it pays. Finishers earn rewards on top of their refund, and MVPs earn more — so the experience ends better than it started.

No. 3

Clarity, fairness, respect

Verified wearable data so nobody can cheat the group. Personal goals so nobody is set up to fail. Human support when life happens. No dark patterns, no fine-print gotchas, no hype.

If a mechanic ever feels unclear, we consider that our bug — and we'd genuinely like to hear about it.

Our story

Two decades on the hardest problem in health

How do you get someone to change their health — and make it stick? We've spent our careers on that question. Motiv is the answer we kept not finding.

What we learned

Every approach taught us something. None of them worked alone.

Data, personalization, habit design, gamification, coaching, the latest research — across products used by hundreds of millions. Each one mattered. The most reliable lever we ever found was a financial incentive tied to verified behavior — and even that couldn't carry the rest on its own.

What incentives can't do

An incentive gets you moving — it can't make the change yours

Two things hold an incentive back on its own. They're expensive and hard to source at scale — someone has to fund them. And they only reach so deep: people learn to game the system, hitting the number without changing the habit underneath. Gaming the goal is the opposite of the point.

What lasts is something money can't buy — the feeling. The excitement of a good week, the hope that this time is different, the quiet happiness of proving it to yourself. That's what gets internalized. For years, the piece we couldn't build was the spark.

The spark

The missing piece turned out to be a person

The spark comes from people. Not from an app notification or a number on a screen — from someone you admire showing up and saying let's go. That pull to begin, and to keep going, is the piece every program we built was missing. Creators already have it.

Put that together with a real financial reward and goals built from your own data, and change starts to take hold — felt, not gamed. The creator brings the spark. Motiv brings the structure. For the first time, they're in one place.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: January 2026

This is placeholder text provided while we finalize Motiv's privacy policy. It is not the final policy. A complete policy describing exactly how we handle your data will be posted here before the platform launches.

1. Information we collect

We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, and the social handle you share when joining the waitlist or creating an account. We also collect basic technical information, like device and usage data, to keep the Service running.

2. Wearable and activity data

If you connect a wearable or health app, we receive the activity data needed to calculate and track your goals — for example, steps, active minutes, or energy. We use this data to operate the Service and do not sell it.

3. How we use information

We use the information we collect to provide and improve the Service, calculate personalized goals, process payments and refunds, communicate with you, and keep the platform safe. We do not use your data to make decisions that have legal effects on you without appropriate safeguards.

4. How we share information

We share information with service providers who help us run Motiv — such as our payment processor, hosting provider, and wearable data partners — only as needed to deliver the Service. We may also share information when required by law. We do not sell your personal information.

5. Data retention

We keep your information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide the Service, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. You can ask us to delete your account and associated data.

6. Your choices and rights

Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, export, or delete your personal information, and to disconnect any linked wearable at any time. To exercise these rights, contact us using the details below.

7. Security

We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your information. No system is perfectly secure, but we work to safeguard your data and to limit access to it.

8. Children's privacy

Motiv is not directed to children under 18, and we do not knowingly collect information from them. If you believe a minor has provided us information, please contact us so we can remove it.

9. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. When we do, we will revise the date above and, where appropriate, notify you of material changes.

10. Contact

Questions about privacy can be sent to hello@heymotiv.com.
